name: baseline
description: Reference arm: the harness's documented default configuration.
config: Run the agent with the default configuration documented in the repo README — no extra extensions, no PI_* toggles, no skills auto-loaded. Verify with: ls extensions && echo "PI_SUBAGENTS is '${PI_SUBAGENTS:-unset}'" (expect unset).

name: piedit-native
description: S8 adoption pair arm: the native edit pipeline (Rust piedit daemon + permission-gate) against the baseline's built-in edit.
config: Run the agent with the permission-gate extension loaded and the piedit extension present (it registers unconditionally — there is no env switch). Verify with: bin/piedit --version (expect a version, not ENOENT). To measure the built-in edit instead, drop the piedit extension from the loaded set; nothing else changes.
